**q25.** Engine: CEL (google/cel-go) wrapped by the in-house `internal/filter` package — `internal/filter/engine.go` (compile), `parser.go` (CEL AST → dialect-agnostic `Condition` tree), `render.go` (tree → SQL), `schema.go` (field/dialect expression table, `DialectSQLite/DialectMySQL/DialectPostgres` at :14-16), `helpers.go:9` (`AppendConditions`). Mechanism: the handler passes the filter strings into `store.FindMemo.Filters` (`server/router/api/v1/memo_service_filter.go`), and each dialect driver calls `filter.DefaultEngine()` + `filter.AppendConditions(..., filter.Dialect<X>, &where, &args)` — `store/db/sqlite/memo.go:57-61`, `store/db/postgres/memo.go:54-58`, `store/db/mysql/memo.go:65-69` — so the same condition tree is rendered with per-dialect expressions and placeholders and appended to the `WHERE` clause.

**q26.** `memo` (the memo row plus comment memo rows — `memo_service.go:574,580`, driver `store/db/sqlite/memo.go:239`), `memo_relation` (both directions — `store/memo.go:142,145`), `attachment` (`store/memo.go:148-156`), and `memo_share` via the schema's `ON DELETE CASCADE` FK on `memo_share.memo_id` (`store/migration/sqlite/LATEST.sql:102-109`). `reaction` rows are read for the webhook payload but not deleted (`memo_service.go:545`).

**q27.** Mechanism: the built `web/dist` output is compiled into the binary with `//go:embed dist/*` and served by Echo's static middleware plus an SPA `index.html` fallback. Wired in `server/router/frontend/frontend.go:21-22` (embed), `:41-60` (`Serve`, static middleware + `spaFallbackMiddleware`), invoked from `server/server.go:70`.

**q28.**
```
s3presign.Runner — RunOnce at startup, then a 12h time.Ticker (server/server.go:162-169; server/runner/s3presign/runner.go:26-40)
internal/webhook async dispatch workers — 4 goroutines started in package init(), driven by a 128-buffered channel fed by PostAsync (internal/webhook/webhook.go:42-54, :184)
```
Unused infra: `internal/scheduler` (a full cron scheduler package, `internal/scheduler/scheduler.go`, `doc.go`) is referenced only by its own tests — the server never registers a job with it. Also `server/runner/memopayload/runner.go` defines `NewRunner`/`RunOnce` that nothing instantiates (only its `RebuildMemoPayload` helper is used, `memo_service.go:108,447`).

**q29.** Interceptor: `authInterceptor` in `web/src/connect.ts:151-183`, installed on the Connect transport at `:189` (a separate no-interceptor `refreshTransport` at `:66` avoids recursion). Tokens: a JWT **access token** sent as `Authorization: Bearer …`, cached in memory/localStorage and cross-tab synced via `web/src/auth-state.ts`, and an HTTP-only **refresh token** cookie (sent because of `credentials: "include"`, `connect.ts:57-62`) used by `AuthService.RefreshToken`; the backend also accepts **personal access tokens**. Backend validation: `server/auth` (`token.go` `ParseAccessTokenV2`/`ParseRefreshToken`, `authenticator.go` `Authenticate`/`AuthenticateByPAT`), invoked from `server/router/api/v1/authz.go` (`Authorizer`) via `NewAuthInterceptor` and the gateway middleware in `server/router/api/v1/v1.go:66-91,134-138`.

**q30.**
```

memo updated: APIV1Service.DispatchMemoUpdatedWebhook — called at server/router/api/v1/memo_update_helpers.go:67

memo comment created: APIV1Service.DispatchMemoCommentCreatedWebhook — called at server/router/api/v1/memo_service_comments.go:119
```
The first three converge on `dispatchMemoRelatedWebhook` (`server/router/api/v1/memo_service_webhooks.go:48`); all four end at `webhook.PostAsync` → `webhook.Post` in `internal/webhook/webhook.go:184` / `:120`.
